text_block_list.text: A piece of fan mail arrived for Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!
For me!? A fan letter!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"In other words, someone out there
is really rooting for me!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: When I think about that... When I think about that...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I just don't know how to express the way I feel right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And then, my body just moved on its own!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'll do my best!
To everyone who supports me, I definitely—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I definitely! Ab-so-luuuuutely!
decided to give you a victory as a present!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And what's needed for that, of course, is...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm going out for a run right now!
Before anyone could stop her, Winning Ticket dashed out onto the dusk-lit grounds.
